issues.title: Reflection: The 2019 HRDC protests that exposed Malawi’s fragile peace, public security
issues.title_en: Reflection: The 2019 HRDC protests that exposed Malawi’s fragile peace, public security
issues.summary: An investigative research and political analysis The 2019 demonstrations organised by the Human Rights Defenders Coalition (HRDC) remain one of the most politically consequential and controversial episodes in Malawi’s recent democratic history, exposing deep divisions over electoral accountability, public security, political freedoms and the protection of ordinary citizens. What began as a campaign demanding accountability […] The post Reflection: The 2019 HRDC protests that exposed Malawi’s fragile peace, public security appeared first on The Maravi Post.
